## Summary of Changes
A concise explanation of what was modified, added, or removed.

## Affected Subsystems
- [ ] Research (`research/` or `references/`)
- [ ] Content Architecture (`content/`)
- [ ] Design System Engine (`design-system/`)
- [ ] Implementation Protocol (`implementation/`)
- [ ] Visual QA & Anti-Slop (`audit/`)

## Design Rationale
Explain why this change improves design intelligence, prevents AI defaults, or refines execution.

## Verification & Parity
- [ ] Changes tested against multiple diverse archetypes (not biased to one style).
- [ ] Relative links verified across modified files.
- [ ] Parity verified between root directory and `sloppi/` mirror.
